items.prompt: A train leaves at 18:45. What time is that on a 12-hour clock?
hints: From 13:00 onwards you subtract 12 from the hours.
items.explanation: 18:45 is after noon, and 18 - 12 = 6. So it is 6:45 p.m.

options.why: You subtracted 10. Subtract 12 from the hours instead.

items.prompt: A film starts at 7:20 p.m. and lasts 2 hours 50 minutes. At what time does it end, using the 24-hour clock?
hints: Start by writing 7:20 p.m. as a 24-hour time.
Add the 50 minutes. Remember 60 minutes make an hour.
items.explanation: 7:20 p.m. is 19:20. Adding 2 hours gives 21:20, and 50 more minutes gives 22:10.

options.why: Minutes cannot go above 59. Carry 60 minutes into the hours.
That is 20 minutes too late. 50 minutes after 21:20 is 22:10.
You changed 70 minutes to 10 minutes but did not add the extra hour.

items.prompt: True or false: The time 15:00 is the same as 3 pm.
True or false: The time 8:30 pm is written as 08:30 on a 24-hour clock.
hints: From 1 pm onwards, add 12 to the hours.
items.explanation: 08:30 is in the morning. 8:30 pm is 8 + 12 = 20, so 20:30.

items.prompt: True or false: The time 00:15 is 15 minutes after midnight.
items.explanation: 00:00 is midnight, so 00:15 is 15 minutes later.
